description: Points d'injection de biométhane dans les réseaux de gaz naturel dans le Loiret is a dataset listed in Geocatalogue France, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by atom.geo-ide.developpement-durable.gouv.fr. Adaptation of bio-methane injection site data from opendata ODRE for the use of stand-alone data in crisis situations. Coverage: FR. The portal shows the English title as "Simple download service (Atom) of the dataset: Biomethane injection points in natural gas networks in the Loiret" (machine-translated by the portal). The listing shows 2021-11-05 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support energy network and generation-capacity studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geocatalogue-fr.
